summary: The escape implementation in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/global/escape.rs follows the spec steps in order. ToString is applied with `?`, and the unescapedSet (ASCII word characters plus @*+-./) is checked correctly. Code units below 256 become %XX and larger ones become %uXXXX, both uppercase and zero-padded, which matches StringPad. Each spec step is kept as a comment above its code. No test-specific branches, hardcoded results, or swallowed errors were found. The only other change is renaming the now-unused `this` and `new_target` parameters to underscore-prefixed names, which is in the same file and is part of the same ticket.
